Chezir חֵזִיר proper name, masculine (compare inscription in RA 1867, plural 7 , Dr Sm xxiii ; Nö ZMG 1886, 162 'pointing — ֵ֯ to avoid offence;' but Nbr Acad. 1887, Dec. 17 compare Talmud & ᵑ7 ( חֲזוּרָא חֵיזוּר, חַזּוּרָא, etc.) pomegranate (and apple ; Syriac , ), compare רִמּוֺן בְּנֵי 2Sam 4:2 , 5 , 9 ) — 1 a priest of 17th course (assigned to David's time) 1Chr 24:15 ; ᵐ5 Χηξειν (16th, 24:14 ), but A Ιεξειρ, ᵐ5 L Χηξειρ. 2 one of those sealed Neh 10:21 ; ᵐ5 Ηξειρ, ᵐ5 L Αξηρ.
